strain: Sprague-Dawley rats; C57BL/6 mice; 5-HT2ARKO (129S6/SvEv background), PV-Cre, Ai32:ChR2, PV-Cre::5-HT2ARKO-res fl/fl transgenic mice

age.evidence: Adult Sprague-Dawley rats, C57BL/6 (Jax Strain 00064, 005304; Jackson Laboratories, USA) mice were used for experiments.

sex.evidence: We first examined whether a single administration of DOI can alter anxiety-like behavior on the EPM in both male and female rats, as well as mice.

dosing.doses_raw: 1 mg/kg (i.p., systemic); 1 µg/µl per hemisphere (intracerebral cannula infusion)
dosing.evidence: For systemic experiments, animals received intraperitoneal (i.p.) injections of vehicle (0.9% saline) or DOI... For stereotactic drug delivery, animals received vehicle (phosphate buffered saline - PBS), DOI (1 µg/µl per hemisphere) ... through pre-implanted cannulas.
animals received vehicle (phosphate buffered saline - PBS), DOI (1 µg/µl per hemisphere) or MDL100907 (1 µg/µl per hemisphere) (Cat. No. 4173, Tocris, UK) through pre-implanted cannulas.
For chemogenetic experiments, animals received i.p. Injections of vehicle (1% DMSO in 0.9% saline), or the DREADD ligand clozapine-N-oxide (CNO, 5 mg/kg).

handling.evidence: No handling/habituation-to-experimenter protocol is described in the methods.

group_housing.evidence: All animals were maintained in the institutional animal house facility on a 12 hour light-dark cycle (7 am-7 pm) with ad libitum access to food and water. (cage density not stated)

day_night_flipped.evidence: All animals were maintained in the institutional animal house facility on a 12 hour light-dark cycle (7 am-7 pm).

assays.assay_description: Sprague-Dawley rats placed in the centre of an EPM (open/closed arms 45 x 10 cm, elevated 60 cm; closed-arm walls 60 cm) and allowed to explore freely for 10 min (15 min in the binned-analysis experiment) in the dark; percent time in open arms, percent time in closed arms and total distance moved tracked with Ethovision XT 11. Variants: acute systemic DOI (1 mg/kg i.p.), intra-vHpc / dHpc / PrL / IL / BA DOI infusion (1 µg/µl per hemisphere), intra-vHpc MDL100907 pretreatment, a modified high-light-contrast EPM, and a 24-h post-dose re-test.

application_type.evidence: Systemic i.p. DOI (1 mg/kg) and direct intracerebral infusion of DOI (1 µg/µL per hemisphere) using cannula implants.

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-test exposure to the EPM apparatus is described.

setup_restrain.evidence: animals were placed in the center of the maze ... and were allowed to freely explore the maze for ten minutes in the dark.

food_restriction.evidence: Home cage had ad libitum food; no food is present in the elevated plus maze during the 10-min test.

water_restriction.evidence: Home cage had ad libitum water; no water is present in the elevated plus maze during the 10-min test.

time_to_assay.evidence: All animals were placed in the EPM or OFT 20 minutes after i.p. drug injection, or immediately after intracerebral drug infusion through the cannula... animals were placed in the EPM 24 hours after treatment with DOI (Figures S1H-S1J).

sample_size.evidence: Systemic: male rats (Veh: n = 10; DOI: n = 7), female rats (Veh: n = 9; DOI: n = 8); vHpc infusion: male (Veh: n = 10, DOI: n = 10), female (Veh: n = 8, DOI: n = 10); MDL study: PBS + Veh: n = 8, MDL + Veh: n = 8, PBS + DOI: n = 7, DOI + MDL: n = 8.

outcomes.summary: Acute systemic DOI (1 mg/kg) produced robust anxiolysis in both male and female rats (increased % time in open arms, decreased % time in closed arms) and reduced total locomotion; the effect was absent 24 h later. Direct DOI infusion into the vHpc CA1/sub (but not dHpc, PrL, IL or BA) phenocopied the anxiolysis without altering locomotion, and intra-vHpc MDL100907 pretreatment blocked the systemic DOI effect.
outcomes.statistics: Systemic: open arms male p < 0.0001 (F(9,6)=1.43), female p = 0.012 (F(7,8)=11.48); closed arms male p < 0.0001 (F(9,6)=4.47), female p = 0.02 (F(7,8)=9.04); locomotion male p < 0.0001, female p < 0.0001. vHpc infusion: open arms male p = 0.004 (F(9,9)=1.23), female p = 0.005 (F(7,9)=1.34); closed arms male p = 0.005 (F(9,9)=1.06), female p = 0.003 (F(7,9)=2.25). MDL: DOI x MDL interaction p = 0.016 (open, F(1,27)=6.48), p = 0.017 (closed, F(1,27)=6.42); main effect MDL F(1,27)=6.59, p=0.016; main effect DOI on locomotion F(1,27)=8.98, p=0.006. Modified EPM p < 0.0001 (Mann-Whitney U).
outcomes.evidence: Both male and female rats acutely administered DOI (1 mg/kg) exhibited robust anxiolytic responses on the EPM... The effects of DOI on anxiety-like behavior on the EPM did not persist 24 h post administration (Figures S1H-S1J).

B1_num_measures.evidence: percent time spent in the open arms... percent time spent in the closed arms... a significant reduction in locomotion in the EPM in DOI-treated rats

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The robust decline in anxiety-like behavior was noted across all bins (5 min) in a 15-min behavioral paradigm (Figures S1A-S1C).

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions, sequences or bout microstructure is reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only zone occupancy (open/closed arm time) and locomotion were measured; no natural behaviours scored.

B6_cognitive.evidence: EPM is based on innate approach-avoidance, requiring no learning.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only univariate t tests/ANOVAs reported for behaviour.

E2_shelter.evidence: Definitionally absent — EPM closed arms are not scored as a shelter.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding or substrate described in the maze.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in the maze.

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are open-ended extensions of a central platform; scored 0 per rubric.

E7_social_context.evidence: animals were placed in the center of the maze ... and were allowed to freely explore the maze — tested individually.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the EPM.

assays.assay_description: C57BL/6 and transgenic mice placed in the centre of an EPM (arms 30 x 5 cm, elevated 50 cm; closed-arm walls 15 cm) and allowed to explore freely for 10 min in the dark; percent time in open arms, percent time in closed arms and total locomotion tracked with Ethovision XT 11. Variants: acute systemic DOI (1 mg/kg i.p.), intra-vHpc CA1/sub DOI infusion in WT and 5-HT2ARKO mice, 5-HT2AR restoration lines (Syn-Cre, CamKII-Cre, PV-Cre::5-HT2ARKO-res fl/fl), chemogenetic hM3Dq/hM4Di activation/inhibition of vHpc PV neurons with CNO, and a modified high-light-contrast EPM.

application_type.evidence: Systemic i.p. DOI (1 mg/kg) and direct intracerebral infusion of DOI (1 µg/µL per hemisphere) into the vHpc CA1/sub region via cannula; CNO given i.p.

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-test exposure to the EPM apparatus is described.

setup_restrain.evidence: animals ... were allowed to freely explore the maze for ten minutes in the dark.

food_restriction.evidence: ad libitum access to food and water in the home cage; no food in the EPM during testing.

water_restriction.evidence: ad libitum access to food and water in the home cage; no water in the EPM during testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: All animals were placed in the EPM or OFT 20 minutes after i.p. drug injection, or immediately after intracerebral drug infusion through the cannula.

sample_size.evidence: Systemic: male mice (Veh: n = 8; DOI: n = 10), female mice (Veh: n = 11; DOI: n = 13); 5-HT2AR WT-Veh: n = 6, DOI: n = 7; 5-HT2AR KO-Veh: n = 9, DOI: n = 9; PV-Cre::5-HT2ARKO-res fl/fl (Veh: n = 10, DOI: n = 10).

outcomes.summary: Acute systemic DOI (1 mg/kg) increased % time in open arms and decreased % time in closed arms in both male and female C57BL/6 mice (with increased locomotion, unlike rats). Intra-vHpc CA1/sub DOI infusion reproduced the anxiolysis in WT but not 5-HT2ARKO mice; restoration of 5-HT2A receptors in neurons generally, or selectively in PV-positive interneurons, reinstated DOI-evoked anxiolysis, whereas restoration in CamKIIα neurons did not. Chemogenetic activation of vHpc PV neurons was anxiolytic and inhibition anxiogenic.
outcomes.statistics: Systemic mice: open arms male p = 0.012 (F(7,9)=1.44), female p < 0.0001 (F(10,12)=1.19); closed arms male p = 0.021 (F(7,9)=2.80), female p = 0.022 (F(10,12)=6.59); locomotion male p = 0.022, female p = 0.005. Modified EPM p < 0.0001 (Mann-Whitney). vHpc infusion mice: open p = 0.034, closed p = 0.022. 5-HT2ARKO x DOI interaction p = 0.037 (open, F(1,27)=4.83), p = 0.032 (closed, F(1,27)=5.13); main effect DOI F(1,27)=10.14, p = 0.004. Syn-Cre rescue: open p = 0.014, closed p = 0.004. PV-Cre::5-HT2ARKO-res: open p = 0.029 (F(9,9)=5.02), closed p = 0.043 (F(9,9)=2.06). hM3Dq+CNO: open p = 0.0005, closed p = 0.002; hM4Di+CNO: open p = 0.005, closed p = 0.021.
outcomes.evidence: male and female C57BL/6 mice also exhibited a robust reduction in anxiety-like behavior on the EPM following acute DOI (1 mg/kg) treatment, with a significant increase in percent time in the open arms (male mice: p = 0.012; female mice: p < 0.0001).

outcomes.summary: Local delivery of DOI into the vHpc CA1/sub region did not increase head twitch responses compared with the animal's own pre-infusion baseline, indicating that this psychedelic-like behavioural signature is not mediated by this region.
outcomes.statistics: Paired t test used comparing baseline HTR and DOI-evoked HTR per animal; no significant effect reported (Figure S3D).
outcomes.evidence: Further, we find that local delivery of DOI in the vHpc CA1/sub region does not evoke the classical head twitch response (HTR) evoked by serotonergic psychedelics (Figure S3D).

judge_notes: Split EPM and OFT by species (rat vs mouse) per rubric rule that the same test in different species = separate assays; deepseek had collapsed across species, qwen had already split EPM but not OFT.

All drug/route/genotype/chemogenetic/antagonist variants of the EPM (systemic DOI, intra-vHpc/dHpc/PrL/IL/BA infusion, MDL100907 pretreatment, 5-HT2ARKO and rescue lines, hM3Dq/hM4Di CNO, modified high-contrast EPM) were merged into a single EPM assay per species.
Dropped all non-behavioural work (neuropixels single-unit recordings, opto-tagging electrophysiology, RNAscope, c-Fos immunofluorescence, western blotting) from the assay list.

B1 corrected to 2-3 (score 1) for EPM and OFT: the reported behavioural measures are % time open arms, % time closed arms and total locomotion (EPM) and % time in centre, centre entries and locomotion (OFT) — deepseek's '4-6' was not supported.
D2 corrected to <15 min (score 0) for the 10-min OFT and the 10-min mouse EPM; deepseek had mis-binned 10 min as 15–60 min.
B2 (within-session binning) scored Yes only for the rat EPM, where 5-min bins across a 15-min session are explicitly reported (Figures S1A–S1C); the mouse EPM has no binned analysis.
D5/D1/D3 follow-up credit given only to the rat EPM, since the 24-h re-test (Figures S1H–S1J) is described in the rat paragraph.
Intracerebral cannula infusion into the vHpc parenchyma scored as route 'other' (not i.c.v.), overriding deepseek.
HTR D1 kept as 'Single session' (modal) because the 45-min baseline and 45-min post-infusion scoring occur contiguously on one day; D4 baseline scored Yes.
gemma4's output was schema-broken (no B/E/D item scores) and contributed only to metadata consensus.
